policy: Discovery is an internal research queue. Promote only when identity, current activity, canonical configuration and source-backed stage are sufficiently verified. Keep real-but-incomplete candidates internal; remove only false, duplicate or no-longer-valid opportunities while preserving negative guards where useful to prevent reintroduction.

negative_records_policy: Archived, rejected and stale records are not public opportunities. Keep them only as internal guards when they prevent false rediscovery or identity collisions; otherwise they can be retired from the active research queue.
